author: Mark Atwood
text: Wave-4 review addendum: ManhattanGrid-specific instance - re-attach (attach/detach with no reset) to a different node moves it in a straight OFF-GRID line toward a stale target, violating axis-lock (mobility.py:838-842, 973-982; verified empirically). Base class docstring says reattachment requires reset() but nothing enforces it - include manager-level enforcement or reset-on-reattach in scope.
